title: Alien Trilogy
native_title: エイリアン・トリロジー
overview:
The terror of space never ends.

All three films of the Alien trilogy, gathered here.

This first-person 3D shooter draws on the Alien, Aliens and Alien 3 films. As Ellen Ripley, now a colonial marine, you are sent to the planet LV426 to wipe out the alien infestation. Fight your way through an overrun human colony, a prison facility and finally the derelict alien ship, completing your mission objectives as the creatures close in from every side.

- Mission briefings set the goal for each stage
- Pick up weapons such as the shotgun and rockets to blast through aliens and obstacles

宇宙の恐怖は終わらない。

エイリアントリロジー3部作ここに集結。
